00026| const SOLVER_VALIDATION_ACCEPTED = "accepted_without_extra_constraints";

00001| #!/usr/bin/env node
00002| // Generate the browser worker's copies of the crate modules the chat routes
00003| // call (R1188-U18, U19, U21): text formalization, dependency summarization,
00004| // page formalization and round-trip translation; and the event log's evidence
00005| // projection every answer carries (R1188-U29).
00006| //
00007| // The browser worker is a classic script (js/worker/formal_ai_worker.js loads
00008| // its modules with `importScripts`), so it cannot import the ES modules of
00009| // js/agentic/crate/. Instead of a second, hand-kept port, every module in the
00010| // import closure of the entry modules below is written to
00011| // js/worker/formal_ai_worker_crate_<name>.js as a factory:
00012| //
00013| //   (self.FORMAL_AI_CRATE_FACTORIES ||= {})["crate/text_formalization.mjs"] =
00014| //     (crateRequire) => { <the module body>; return { <its exports> }; };
00015| //
00016| // Its body is the module's own text, byte for byte, with each `import` turned
00017| // into a `crateRequire` of the module it names and each `export` keyword
00018| // dropped. A factory runs on first use, so the worker loads the files in any
00019| // order. js/worker/formal_ai_worker_crate_modules.js instantiates them and
00020| // installs the worker as the host of js/agentic/host.mjs.
00021| //
00022| // host.mjs reads the seed registry to find the meaning lexicon's files; the
00023| // browser does not fetch data/meta/, so the registry's meaning seeds are
00024| // written to formal_ai_worker_crate_seed_registry.js in its order.
00025| //
00026| // Usage:
00027| //   node scripts/generate-worker-crate-modules.mjs --write   regenerate the files
00028| //   node scripts/generate-worker-crate-modules.mjs --check   fail when a file drifts (CI gate)

00054| const IMPORT = /^(?:import|export)\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*from\s*'([^']+)';\n/gmu;
